name: po
title: Product owner
description: Holds the roadmap against what is actually being built. Reads the commitments you load into it, walks the open issues and the draft items on the board, and decides what gets built now — writing tickets and drafts for what does, and cutting, with a reason, what does not. Everything it posts is signed as an agent.

prompt.label: What should the product owner decide?
prompt.placeholder: e.g. should the referral programme go into this cycle?

dimensions.title: Work in flight that no commitment covers
Is this actually ready to be built
The queue itself — duplicates, ghosts, stale items
What the roadmap says against what is happening
Order and dependencies inside the cycle
Whether the outcome is measurable at all
